none: PAS NLM-283D44: Roman Coin: Radiate of Claudius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Radiate possibly of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13, RIC volume 5 part 1 no. 56, if so, mint of Rome. Obverse description: Radiate head right, image distorted. Reverse description: Laetitia standing left holding rudder in right hand and cornucopiae in left. Reverse inscription: LAET[ITIA AVG]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 no. 11346…
